integrity: The all-parameter fidelity formula is analytic. The bundled checker uses exact rational arithmetic only as a corroborating replay of the parity calculation and the explicit counterexample.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the bidirectional protocol under the standard independent tensor-product bit-flip channel generated by the one-qubit Kraus operators stated in the source. It does not assess the cyclic protocol or the other noise models, and it does not exclude perfect invariance under a separately specified correlated global flip model.
title: Independent bit-flip noise breaks the claimed perfect bidirectional teleportation fidelity
